verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page lists first-party HubSpot and Salesforce integrations, so it has its own CRM integration capability, but nothing describes what those integrations do. The API and MCP server are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documentation that calls and texts are logged to the CRM automatically, contact matching against the right CRM record, details of what gets synced (recordings, transcripts, SMS threads), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
